problem: P0 applications contain hundreds of generated SDK entity, auth and function calls. Rewriting call sites individually would multiply migration risk.
migration_mechanism: Replace the generated SDK client seam per extracted app. Existing entity, auth, function and Core call sites remain structurally compatible while transport authority moves to Evercraft.
security: anonymous read and write are disabled by default
production auth must pass through an admitted auth adapter
function invocation must pass through the Systemia function router
data remains on authorized Evercraft runtime capacity
migration does not copy credentials into source control
